name: code-quality-metrics
source_status: deterministic local evidence contract; not runtime activation or promotion proof

conditional_gates.performance: required when applicable; otherwise status must be not_applicable
conditional_gates.cost_latency: required when applicable; otherwise status must be not_applicable

decision_rules: missing required evidence blocks promotion and is never converted to zero or success
model self-scores are diagnostic only and cannot affect promotion_allowed
reviewer verdict is a separate required gate
patch size and test churn are anomaly warnings, not optimization targets
performance and cost/latency evidence are required only when applicable
